notes.title: Demo Temporarily Closed After a Successful April Fools
notes.content:
JUST WANT TO SAY THANK YOU!

We want to thank every single person who played the demo, made videos, shared feedback, and joined the conversation. This past week has been overwhelming in the best way. The response far exceeded our expectations, with over a million impressions and thousands of players diving into the world of Sinfeld: Evil Resident.

The demo was always meant to gather feedback and see how the game landed in the wild. We’ve now collected everything we need, from technical notes to emotional meltdowns. With that, we’re taking the demo offline while we focus on the next build.

We now have the full foundation in place. The storytelling tools, gameplay systems, and environments are all working. From here, we’re shifting our focus to building out the rest of the game. We'll be fixing some audio bugs, improving the overall experience, and expanding the story.

There’s a good chance an updated version of the demo will return down the line as development evolves. This is just the start.

Thanks again for being part of this. We’ll be back soon.


- RareBird Games
